purpose: Qualify the 1,227 PIT fundamental source fields without using performance outcomes.

qualified_root: unit and semantic certainty asserted from an exact source field contract
coverage ratio >= 0.10 unless a declared sector applicability contract exists
direct level has a defensible cross-sectional meaning or an explicit aggregation
derived_only: currency statement levels require scale normalization or within-company change
source-reported YoY has its own representation identity
internally derived YoY uses the base level and a different representation identity
event_only: field expresses a unique disclosure occurrence or timing episode rather than a reusable numeric level
condition_only: field has an asserted boolean, applicability, or financial-company-type contract
industry_specific: native name suggests a financial-institution scope but unit or sector applicability remains unresolved
state is review-only and has no allowed search route until the contract is asserted
low_coverage_archive: coverage ratio < 0.10 and no asserted industry applicability
archive state has no allowed search route
semantics_unresolved: unit, period basis, sign, or meaning cannot be asserted from local source evidence
unresolved state has no search-eligible representation and no allowed search route
pit_unresolved: a blocked registry placeholder may document the missing capability but cannot be search eligible

canonical_representation_contract.disclosure_episode_deduplication: one source family episode one vote

hard_rules: Do not use return, label, reward, IC, selector rank, survivor status, validation, holdout, or 2026 data to qualify fields.
Source-reported YoY and internally computed YoY must have different representation IDs.
Current-snapshot-only fields cannot claim historical revision replay.
No disclosure event may be created after the source release maximum observable time.
A field may produce multiple representations, but each representation has one typed route contract.
Raw 1,227-field exposure to generators is forbidden.
Unit-, period-, or applicability-unresolved raw levels fail closed.
